pattern: Navigation landmark with an ordered list of steps (progress indicator). Reachable steps are native links or buttons; the current step is marked with aria-current="step". Not a tablist.

aria.value: rtl when direction is 'rtl'; absent otherwise

keyboard.action: Moves between reachable steps (native tab order). The current step and unreachable steps are not Tab stops.
Emits cancelable aui-navigate; unless prevented, the step becomes current and aui-change is emitted. Links then navigate natively.

focus: Each reachable step is one Tab stop. After a button step is activated, focus moves to the new current step (tabindex=-1), so focus is not lost when the activated control is re-rendered as text. After a link step is activated, focus is not moved. update() and configuration changes rebuild the list and do not restore focus.
notes: Step status is conveyed as text: a visually hidden "Completed" or "Error" inside the step control and a visible "Optional" hint, not by color or icon alone.
The ordered list conveys the number of steps and each step's position.
Disabled and unreachable steps are plain text, so they are announced but not operable.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Unreachable steps are not exposed as disabled controls; users hear them as text without an explanation of why they cannot be activated.
